display_name.zh: DSH mini — DeepSeek Harness 引擎

description.zh: 把 dsh-mini 的便携引擎注册为 Operit 的 AI provider：DSH 官方 agent loop（turn/step 状态机、工具调度、会话）跑在 Operit 的 JS 运行时里，工具走 Operit 的终端/文件/网络触手。
description.en: Registers the dsh-mini portable engine as an Operit AI provider: the official DSH agent loop (turn/step machine, tool scheduling, sessions) runs inside Operit's JS runtime, with tools routed through Operit's terminal/filesystem/network capabilities.
